newsitem.title: USA: Dow slightly down, Nasdaq holds higher ground.
newsitem.headline: Dow slightly down, Nasdaq holds higher ground.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks eased off session lows on Wednesday, taking some support from the bond market but staying in a trading range, while Nasdaq held steady as the technology sector turned itself around.

The Dow industrials were off around 16 points at 7296. An early morning decline in the index caused the New York Stock Exchange to set curbs on index arbitrage trading at 1006 EDT/1406 GMT, then lift them 20 minutes later.
The long bond was off 6/32 at a 6.89 percent yield.
Nasdaq was up 1.75 points at around 1387, below session highs but still positive as battered tech stocks recovered.
